description: v5: implement owns code and tests (no test role, no red check, no lanes); one REVIEW stage (POLISH merged in); codeg MCP is the only executor; arbor.py finish runs once before the merge
changelog: The test role, the red check, the tests/impl lanes and the test_paths config are gone: implement writes code and tests together and runs the contract's auto checks green before committing. POLISH is folded into REVIEW: light runs one self-check reviewer then fix; standard / full run simplify, 2 / 3 candidate reviewers, verify, fix and (full) a sweep, with a cap of 2 fix rounds in every tier. decide impl|contract classifies a red gate (tests is gone). The mandate has three gates (contract, plausible, merge); STOP always asks. Only codeg-mcp executors remain: the codeg-cli command executor, --executor and arbor.py canary are removed. arbor.py finish writes the scorecard and prints the merge command in one run; after the merge it cleans up. A task that is still in POLISH, in a test step or running lanes cannot be driven by the new driver: finish it on the old version or abandon it. Remove a stale test_paths: section, codeg-cli executor and mandate stop: entries from .arbor/config.yaml by hand.

migrations.description: v4 test role instructions, removed in v5

migrationGuide: Finish or abandon any task still in POLISH, in a test step or running tests/impl lanes before updating; the v5 driver cannot drive them. Edit .arbor/config.yaml by hand: delete the test_paths: section, any codeg-cli (type: command) executor and the stop: lines under mandate:. Review .arbor/agents/implement.md, fix.md, simplify.md and review.md for local edits: implement now owns the tests. Contracts no longer need a Test paths section; Interface pins are optional.
